name: Lune
source: The winged twin older brother. He escaped from an orphanage with his younger brother Luna, and they have lived together ever since. He is skillful with his hands, making accessories to sell for a living. He cares deeply for Luna and is very nurturing. In addition to being able to fly, he can manipulate wind and fire.
